headline: Yul And Leo Edochie Reflect On Final Moments Of Pete Edochie
seoTitle: Yul and Leo Edochie Remember Pete Edochie
metaDescription: Yul and Leo Edochie share reflections on the final moments of their father, the late Nollywood actor Pete Edochie, following his battle with cancer.
aiSummaryBullets: Actor Yul Edochie shared an account of his father's final words at the hospital on social media.
Leo Edochie disclosed that his father struggled with prostate cancer for six years prior to his passing.
The family reported that the veteran actor expressed a preference for death over extended medical suffering.
aiContextParagraph: Veteran Nollywood actor Pete Edochie has died following a long-term battle with prostate cancer. His sons, Yul and Leo Edochie, have recently spoken out regarding their father's final days and his health challenges. According to Leo Edochie, the actor had been living with prostate cancer for approximately six years before his death. In a separate public tribute shared on social media, Yul Edochie recounted being at his father's side in the hospital, noting that the actor requested to hold his hand during his final moments. The family's reflections provide insight into the actor's perspective on his terminal condition, with reports indicating that he had previously expressed a desire to avoid prolonged suffering. These accounts from his children serve as a personal look at the end of the life of a prominent figure in the Nigerian film industry.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending following public social media tributes from the actor's family, covered by two independent news outlets.
